text:
Type: grey woven rattan storage basket
Use: storing blankets, magazines or small things on a shelf or the floor; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: rustic, coastal, farmhouse
Materials: thick hand-woven rattan in a grey-washed finish
Colors: grey brown, driftwood grey
Shape: low square basket with slightly flared sides, chunky braided rim, two cut-out side handles, sturdy and medium in visual weight
Feel: natural, rustic, relaxed, handmade
Goes with: open shelving, light or dark wood, linen, green plants; coastal, farmhouse or rustic rooms

product.name: BYHOLMA
product.description: The basket is hand woven and therefore has a  unique look.
